dependencies.exclusionReason: Normal GCC compiler runtime implementing compiler/atomic standard interfaces; System Libraries under GPLv3 section 1. No claim of pristine upstream GCC package patch state.

Normal MinGW-w64 compiler C runtime implementing standard C/Windows interfaces; System Libraries under GPLv3 section 1. Exact binary toolchain package versions/hashes and complete installed runtime notices retained. No assertion that upstream-only source reconstructs MSYS2 packages.

Actual statically linked pthread clock/misc/nanosleep/thread objects are recorded. This is the POSIX standard-interface runtime shipped normally with MinGW-w64 GCC, classified as a compiler System Library under GPLv3 section 1; publicly available MinGW-w64 source implements the interface. Complete MIT/BSD notices from installed winpthreads/COPYING and exact compiler package hashes retained; not omitted as an unknown third-party codec.
MinGW compiler import/interface libraries address operating-system Windows/UCRT components. Not additional shipped DLLs; normal compiler/OS System Libraries. Complete MinGW runtime notices retained.
